findings: S110 six-section drawer hid tab buttons from the responsive capture path until their group was expanded.
Public page links used browser-default blue in both themes.
About described the shipped rival trade market and Front Office Advisor as upcoming.
A CSS display rule exposed the empty GM commitment panel before it had content.
fixesApplied: Capture opens the matching drawer group through its visible toggle; drawer screenshots use the viewport.
Global links use the theme-aware accent token; dark and light public pages were recaptured and inspected.
About now separates playable systems from the privacy-gated Community Stats milestone.
The empty commitment panel honors hidden; the focused browser spec checks its initial state.
